Warhammer 40,000 Space Marine Review


A Warhammer 40,000 experience unlike any you’ve had before awaits you here and now!


Some key points that this game offers:

1.	Devastating Weaponry
2.	Stunning Visuals.
3.	Master Crafted Story Line.
4.	Brutal Online PVP.

Gameplay & Controls:

The game can be played with either mouse and keyboard or controller when you play on PC. It offers full controller support, so in terms of comfort you are all set here. The choice remains solely on which option you prefer. Key binding can be customized to your specific requirements as well.

We play in Third Person view giving us an up close and personal look at how devastating a Space Marine can be. We will travel through various locations taking on an unending swarm of Orks, bloodthirsty and ready for a fight. A deadly arsenal is available to you in the form of progression pickups as you progress in the game. Tactical planning and execution is required here, this is not a run and gun game… You will die. Make use of close combat combos to bring death to your enemies along with a full range of ranged fire support.

Graphics:

To say that this game is gorgeous, truly is an understatement. This game is absolutely beautiful, whether it is the stunning character models or the environment. Everything has been created and implemented gorgeously to give us a Life Action Movie feel.
Under the settings there are numerous options to customize your game. 

Sounds:

The Voice acting has been performed and captured stunningly adding to the Live Action feel that the game presents. Background sounds bring this Forge World to life in all its splendour. Each location you visit has its own background sounds and music to ensure the experience is unforgettable.

Under the settings you have full volume control. 

Replayability:

The game offers three difficulties and some collectables that are hidden throughout the game. Completing these and the other Singleplayer achievements alone will keep you busy.
Once that has been completed you can take to multiplayer where a variety of modes are available to you… 

MGR Gaming’s Conclusions:
Spoilers ahead:

A Forge world is facing a full Ork invasion; This Forge world is of critical importance and cannot be lost. A Fleet is being dispatched to aid against the invasion. However, whilst the fleet is en route it is up to you Captain Titus of the Ultramarines to lead a preemptive strike against the enemy.

The story line has been beautiful sculpted and introduced to the game. To say that the game resembles that of a live action film does not do it justice. Every aspect of the game has been created with so much care and attention to detail to ensure the experience will not be easily forgotten. The gameplay itself gives the player a real challenge from start to finish. Master the combat mechanics of the game to truly master Space Marine.

Score 8
